# Qdrant rich formula source oracle

Generated by `rtk proxy python3 scripts/qdrant_formula_payload_reference.py` from
Qdrant `74f3e85b9473c62560006c043e13737ce6b48412` (Apache-2.0).

1,068 cases compile and execute 15 extracted, unchanged upstream units: JSON-path
types/traversal/display/wildcard suffix, VariableId parsing, the authoritative
payload retriever, formula score/evaluation/value/default conversion and decay
functions. The full original nom path-parser file is also compiled. The fixture
contains source/unit/scaffold/Cargo.lock SHA-256 values. Exact F32 result bits
or source errors are produced by Rust, never by a Python implementation.

The adapter uses actual serde_json 1.0.151 with preserve_order, nom 8.0.0, a
Vec-backed MultiValue, and a map-backed payload provider/no-op hardware counter.
The older scalar-oracle scaffold supplies expression/error wrappers; this oracle
replaces its String paths and custom numbers with the source paths and serde_json
numbers. Geo/date adapters are unused and deliberately unsupported. Conditions,
typed indexes, shard merging, REST/gRPC and full server behavior are not tested.

Coverage includes nested/index/wildcard paths, terminal vs middle wildcard
flattening, absent/empty/null, singleton/multiple/nested arrays, UInt64, quoted
empty/NUL/Unicode keys, normalized defaults, nonnumeric score defaults and
short-circuit expressions. Public tests store all payload cases through actual
collection writes and exercise Python/Arrow outputs; native tests additionally
cover maximum depth, aggregate default limits and retained snapshots.
